fusion.productAria: Product sample: standalone product photo whose shape, color, and texture stay unchanged
fusion.sceneAria: Scene sample: dashed frame shows scene supplies background only; scene objects stay out of the product
fusion.compositeAria: Composite sample: product placed unchanged into the new scene while scene props remain in the background
fusion.note: Solid frame = product kept unchanged; dashed frame = scene supplies background only and props won't merge into the product.

inpaint.sourceAria: Original sample: unwanted clutter next to the product
inpaint.removeMaskAria: Paint sample: mask covers clutter while product remains untouched
inpaint.repaintMaskAria: Paint & describe sample: mask covers clutter and prompt applies only inside this region
inpaint.removeResultAria: Erase result sample: clutter removed and dashed frame filled with AI background
inpaint.repaintResultAria: Inpaint result sample: masked area replaced according to description
inpaint.removeNote: Red = painted mask; dashed frame = AI-filled background while everything else stays unchanged.
inpaint.repaintNote: Red = painted area; speech bubble = description applied only inside this area while everything else stays unchanged.

outpaint.sourceAria: Original sample: image ends at the solid frame with no content outside
outpaint.dragAria: Drag sample: drag the green dashed frame outward; light green area will be filled by AI
outpaint.resultAria: Expanded sample: new background filled outside the frame while product size and position stay unchanged
outpaint.note: Green dashed frame = target canvas (drag to choose how much to expand); solid frame = original pixels kept intact.

relight.frontAria: Front light sample: light comes from the camera direction; shadow falls behind product
relight.leftAria: Left light sample: light comes from the left; shadow falls to the right
relight.backAria: Backlight sample: light from behind product; rim glows and shadow casts toward camera
relight.note: Solid arrow = key light direction; dashed line = shadow. Camera icon = front light; glow behind product = backlight.

retouch.sourceAria: Original sample: dust spots and dark shadow on product surface
retouch.retouchedAria: Retouched sample: dust removed and dark shadow brightened
retouch.note: Fixes dust, dark shadows, and existing edges only; text, logos, and product colors stay unchanged.

smartEdit.bgAria: Change background sample: keep product and place into a new scene
smartEdit.colorAria: Recolor sample: change only product color or material
smartEdit.propsAria: Add props sample: add accessories or decor around the product
smartEdit.note: Dashed frame & highlight = areas changed by your prompt; state what to preserve in your prompt.

variation.sourceAria: Original sample: product photo on white background
variation.sceneAria: Variation sample: keep product and swap background to outdoor wooden table
variation.layoutAria: Variation sample: keep product and switch to top-down minimalist framing
variation.note: Concept: keep the product recognizable while varying the scene or framing; generate multiple variants at once.
